fulfillDepositRequest(uint256).notice: Mark an ERC-7540 deposit request claimable. ERC-7540 does not specify the operator settlement method. This test-only external operator action makes a pending request claimable before the guarded three-argument ``deposit`` claim emits its standard ``Deposit``.

fulfillRedeemRequest(uint256).notice: Mark an Accountable/ERC-7540 redemption request claimable. The deployed protocol executes this strategy-operator step separately from the asset manager's guarded request and claim calls.
